output.one_liner: Squarespace is a website and ecommerce platform with REST APIs and an official MCP server for building integrations and managing stores.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is the primary authentication method with self-serve credential generation available as of July 27, 2026.

evidence.snippet: Instant Credential Generation: Generate OAuth client IDs and secrets immediately for development and testing.

access.notes: Developers can generate OAuth credentials immediately for free in Demo Mode for development and testing. Production use requires requesting a review through the developer dashboard.

evidence.snippet: all new applications created via the self-service tool will enter Demo Mode by default.
When you are ready to take your integration live, simply request a review directly from the app details page in your dashboard.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve OAuth credentials available immediately for development, but production deployment requires Squarespace app review and approval.

overview_evidence.snippet: Everything you need to build and publish external apps – reliable APIs, clear documentation, and a marketplace to reach Squarespace's global customer base.
Commerce APIs. Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions.
